As to how to start create here's the basic:
Andesite alloy is basically the foundation of the mod, you need to gather andesite and iron (turn into nuggets) to craft the alloys. Then use the alloy on wood to get andesite casing
From here you can build many energy sources but water wheels is the easiest from my experience. You'll need to craft a lot of big water wheels and cogwheels & shaft to run power to your machines.
After this is up to you but i usualy start right into ore processing (futher info in my reply)

Author: @ariane19.
Content: The whale at 20:55 is a sperm whale, which is the current largest toothed whale. It only has teeth on it's lower jaw that fit into sockets on the upper jaw however it might necessarily even need these for capturing and eating squids (though they certainly help with suction and keeping the prey in place). They were a prime target for whaling from 18th to the 20th as their spermaceti obtained from the spermaceti organ, and sperm oil obtained from it's blubber were in high demand for use in things such as candles, soap, cosmetics, machine oil etc. They were whaled to the point that they are now classified as threatened (not endangered yet) and are locally extinct in southern Australia, which is a significant shift from how abundant they were before the whaling industry developed. Luckily they're protected now so that their species might recover from the whaling craze. Hope this gives some info and clarity on it <3

Author: @macktuesday0905
Content:
omg how exciting ! my siblings and i have been playing this modpack together for a month or so and it's been a blast.

a few piece of advice i found super helpful
- you can craft sandpaper with sand and paper, which when held offhand while mainhanding rough ores will polish them. rough emerald -> emerald, rough diamond->diamond etc etc. it's a great way to polish your gemstones in earlier game since you don't have to craft a diamond grindstone
- you can harvest dead dragons by right clicking them with empty hands, it may take a bit of clicking to find the hitbox for it though. dragon bones craft powerful weapons, armors, and tools
- you have a bunch of extra item slots for your player if you click the little circle thing next to your helmet slot in your inventory. i believe the mod is curios and it adds a backpack slot so you can wear your chestplate and the backpack at the same time

Author: @notHumanEater
Content:
About the dragon corpses/skeletons, the way you loot them, is you have to find their hitbox around the centre, and then right click with an empty hand. This will begin to loot the corpse/skeleton. You will get a stage 1-5 skull from the body, and bones. If the corpse still has skin on it, you will get dragon scales and a heart too. Later on in the game, you can instead use a glass bottle on the corpses with skin to harvest their blood, which is useful for late game crafting. However, harvesting blood will reduce/completely remove, your ability to get scales from that corpse. Also, random skeletons found on the surface will always be stage 1-3 dragons. Alive wild dragons in the surface will be found in nests, of their specific type, ice, fire, or lightning. Dragons on the surface will always be stage 1-3. Stage 4-5 dragons can only be found underground in little caverns. Stage 4-5 female dragons will drop eggs, a stage 4 female will always drop 1, but a stage 5 female can drop 1-2. Eggs can be hatched under certain conditions depending on the type of dragon (ice eggs have to be hatched in a water source block, fire eggs have to be placed in fire (netherack is recommended, and lightning dragons have to be hatched in the rain, during a thunderstorm). Frost/Fire/Lightning lily mixtures are used to breed a male and female dragon of the same type (they both must be stage 4+. 
I hope this explains the basics of dragons in the Ice And Fire mod.

Author: @gronahoghatten5503
Content:
I've got a few tips for you:

1. The toolboxes you found near the beginning can be used as portable storage, but they’re not as effective as backpacks. I recommend going back to the structures you visited at 6:00 and 8:00 to get the toolboxes there regardless.

2. I think it'd be a good idea to go back and get the rose quartz as well as the powdered obsidian you found at 18:50 because I personally find getting rose quartz to be a pain. Also, they're very important materials for progressing in the Create mod.

3. The structure you found at 20:40 is an archaeological site, where you can dig up (or brush off) fossils and treasures. The house where you found the villager skull is also an archaeological site, and you can find fossils there too.

4. You can turn water wheels into large water wheels by surrounding them with planks. This allows them to power more machinery because they generate more stress units. Note that they also move slower than regular water wheels, but you can counteract that by placing a small water wheel at the end of a chain of large water wheels. Also, large water wheels look a lot cooler, and you can customize them by right-clicking with planks.

5. Some airships seem to have windmill bearings and sails (the spinning parts). You might want to take those, as you could use them to build a functional windmill. However, keep in mind that they might not be windmill bearings but mechanical bearings instead. Those function completely differently from each other, so it's best to use the Ponder function for more info.

That's all got, I'm pretty sure.

Content:
The dragon you stumbled upon was from the ice and fire mod (or the fire and ice i forgot).

but you asked how to collect it you got to just right click until they disappear.

 one is fire you put netherack under it and then put it on that and light it on fire It will not burn IF you put the egg before the fire if you place the fire then the egg it will burn

two (i think ice but if not water) you put it in water

and it takes a long time to hatch but if you dont do this to the egg they dont hatch at all.

and the different element the different color fire is red and water (i think) is blue.

just know not all nests are on the surface most of the girls are in the ground.

also if you kill it instead of finding it died then you have two choses one you just right cilck it and get scales or two you use bottles too get dragons breath.

for more info just search *dragon* in minecraft just enough items mod (btw you aready have it) hope i helped.
